import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# --- Data Preparation ---
# Extract the hour from the 'time' column
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time'], format='%H:%M').dt.hour

# Identify the top 7 products by total sales to keep the heatmap focused
top_products = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().nlargest(7).index

# Filter the DataFrame to include only these top-selling products
df_top_products = df[df['product'].isin(top_products)]

# Create a pivot table: hours as rows, products as columns, and total sales as values
sales_pivot = df_top_products.pivot_table(
    index='hour',
    columns='product',
    values='total',
    aggfunc='sum',
    fill_value=0
)

# Ensure the columns are in order of total sales (descending) for better visual flow
sales_pivot = sales_pivot[top_products]

# --- Visualization ---
# Set the style and create the figure
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create the heatmap
heatmap = sns.heatmap(
    sales_pivot,
    cmap='YlGnBu',
    linewidths=.5,
    linecolor='lightgray',
    ax=ax,
    cbar_kws={'label': 'Total Sales ($)'}
)

# --- Customization and Labeling ---
# Set the main title and axis labels with appropriate font sizes
ax.set_title('Peak Sales Hours for Top-Selling Products', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', labelpad=15)
ax.set_ylabel('Hour of the Day (24-hour format)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', labelpad=15)

# Improve readability of tick labels
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=11)
plt.yticks(rotation=0, fontsize=10)

# Format the y-axis to clearly show hours
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FormatStrFormatter('%02d:00'))

# Adjust layout to prevent labels from being cut off
fig.tight_layout()

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
